# Media

This page presents selected learning resources that supported my development in Python-based data analytics.

Rather than listing general tutorials, these resources were chosen based on their practical, hands-on approach and their relevance to real-world data analysis workflows.

These resources played a key role in helping me build foundational skills in data cleaning, analysis, and visualisation, which were directly applied in my project work.

<div class="media-cards">

<div class="media-card">

## Data Analysis with Python – freeCodeCamp

<iframe width="100%" height="315"
src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/r-uOLxNrNk8"
title="Data Analysis with Python"
frameborder="0"
allowfullscreen>
</iframe>

**Duration:** ~4 hours  

A comprehensive course covering data loading, cleaning, and visualisation using pandas and NumPy.

**What I gained:**  

This resource helped me understand how to structure data analysis workflows and apply pandas functions to real datasets.

</div>

<div class="media-card">

## Python Pandas Tutorial Series – Corey Schafer

<iframe width="100%" height="315"
src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/vmEHCJofslg"
title="Pandas Tutorial Series"
frameborder="0"
allowfullscreen>
</iframe>

**Duration:** ~5 hours (playlist)  

A structured, step-by-step series covering pandas fundamentals, filtering, grouping, handling missing data, time-series analysis, and working with files such as CSV and SQL.

**What I gained:** 

This resource helped me build confidence in using pandas for data manipulation.

</div>

<div class="media-card">

<iframe width="100%" height="315"

This resource improved my understanding of data cleaning and transformation.

<div class="media-card">

## Pandas Full Course – Derek Banas

<iframe width="100%" height="315"

<div class="media-card">

## Data Analyst Portfolio Project – Alex The Analyst

<iframe width="100%" height="315"
src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/qfyynHBFOsM"

This resource helped me understand how to structure portfolio-ready projects and present data analysis work in a clear and practical way.

These resources were instrumental in building my technical foundation and bridging the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application.
They directly supported the development of my project work and helped me transition into a more hands-on, applied approach to analytics.
